references.text: The same principle that all Israel should hear and fear when a transgression is punished, so that they do not commit such evil again.
Identical wording stating that the others should hear and fear, and never again do such evil, in the context of false witnesses.
The same purpose for public punishment: all Israel should hear and fear, through the stoning of a rebellious son.
The law was read aloud to all the people, including women, children, and foreigners, so that everyone could hear and learn to fear the Lord.
Achan's sin and punishment served as a warning for all Israel, so that the people would fear and not act presumptuously.
Paul instructs Timothy to rebuke sinners publicly, so that others will also have fear—the same principle found in Deuteronomy.
